TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

        focus: "Squat, deadlift, leg press, calves (higher intensity)"
      DAY Thursday "Plyometric & Power":
        focus: "Box jump, jump squat, push up, kettlebell swing (higher intensity)"
      DAY Thursday "HIIT":
        focus: "Cycling intervals (10x0:30 rpe 9, 1:30 rest)"
      DAY Friday "Upper Body Pull":

      DAY Saturday "Cardio Health":

        focus: "Squat, front squat, romanian deadlift, calves (strength focus)"

      DAY Thursday "HIIT":
        focus: "Cycling intervals (10x0:30 rpe 9, 1:30 rest)"
      DAY Friday "Upper Body Pull":
        focus: "Pull up, barbell row, face pull, biceps (strength focus)"
      DAY Saturday "Cardio Health":
        focus: "Steady-state cycling"
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday "Upper Body Push":
        focus: "Bench press, incline press, tricep dip, delts (strength focus)"
      DAY Tuesday "Cardio Health":
